0022600170.text: The Warriors (4-3, on a four-game winning streak) host the Suns (1-3, on a two-game losing streak) in Golden State's eighth game of the season. Golden State is 2nd in the Pacific, 1 game back, and 9th in the West, while Phoenix is 3rd in the Pacific, 2.5 games back, and 12th in the West. Golden State is without Al Horford (rest), Gui Santos (knee), Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee surgery), and Brandon Williams is day-to-day with a quadriceps bruise and a game-time decision, while Phoenix is without Mark Williams (shoulder surgery). The Warriors trail 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after the Suns beat them 131-122 in Phoenix on October 24, though Golden State won the 2025-26 series 3-1.
